record.q: January 2025 marks the halfway point of my first term as your Attorney General.

record.q: Chair, National Lieutenant Governors Association, 2010-11 (chair, southern regional executive committee, 2007-08; treasurer, 2008-09; vice-chair, 2009-10).

record.t: Served as Vice-Chair of the Judiciary Committee in the Maryland House of Delegates starting in 2003 (2003).

record.t: Won the Democratic primary for Maryland attorney general, defeating Katie Curran O'Malley.
record.q: Rep. Anthony Brown defeated ex-Baltimore City District Judge Katie Curran O’Malley in the Democratic primary for Maryland attorney general on Tuesday

record.t: Announced that a coalition of 17 attorneys general, including Maryland, secured relief from conditions the Trump administration attempted to place on Fair Housing Assistance Program funding.
record.q: Attorney General Anthony G. Brown, as part of a coalition of 17 attorneys general, announced that the coalition has secured relief from unlawful conditions the Trump administration attempted to place on Fair Housing Assistance Program (FHAP) funding.

record.t: Filed a lawsuit with Prince George's County to stop the Trump administration from moving the new FBI headquarters project out of Greenbelt, Maryland, and redirecting over $1 billion in funding.
record.q: Attorney General Anthony G. Brown, alongside Prince George's County, today filed a lawsuit to stop the Trump administration's unlawful attempt to sabotage the new FBI headquarters project in Greenbelt, Maryland, and redirect over $1 billion in congressionally appropriated funding to a different location.

record.t: Joined a coalition of 21 attorneys general in filing an amicus brief supporting a challenge to the 2017 and 2018 regulations on employer coverage of contraception under the Affordable Care Act.
record.q: Attorney General Anthony G. Brown today joined a coalition of 21 attorneys general in filing an amicus brief in support of a challenge to the first Trump administration’s 2017 and 2018 regulations
